component_boundaries.responsibility: Own the accepted three-region vertical workspace shell and composition slots.
Own the accepted desktop split-pane relationship without changing sidebar/content visual hierarchy.
Reuse the project-native command palette integration boundary without redesigning the palette.

responsive_engineering.strategy: Preserve desktop horizontal split; use accepted drawer/collapse behavior below the handoff breakpoints rather than generic stacking.
Preserve handoff region order and overlay navigation behavior on mobile.

composition_ownership.strategy: CSS grid shell with fixed header, flexible primary region, and docked inspector slot.
Header sub-layout owns breadcrumb/action grouping while visual emphasis remains Cloak-owned.
Responsive container owns split/collapse mechanics without changing accepted visual intent.

layer_relationships.relationship: Own overlay portal and stacking context above shell surfaces; preserve focus and escape lifecycle.
Own drawer mount/unmount and pointer interception only at accepted responsive states.

data_flow_boundaries.contract: Repository/workspace context enters through explicit props/context boundary; no visual decisions are derived from transport details.
Active document identity/content remains state input; viewer presentation remains bounded by the accepted handoff.

reusable_component_strategy.reason: Project-native component already satisfies the accepted command-palette role.
Reuse when they preserve required region and responsive behavior; do not force reuse if fidelity would be lost.

integration_boundaries.rule: Clockwork consumes accepted visible intent without mutating it.
Provides engineering boundaries only; implementation remains Ponytail-owned.

dependency_boundaries.rule: May depend inward on stable project-native primitives that preserve fidelity.

preserve: Preserve every accepted UIEF-4 macro-composition identity in composition_ownership.
Preserve accepted responsive transformations without replacing them with generic stacking.
Preserve Cloak ownership of visible intent, hierarchy, spacing, typography, interactions, and accessibility requirements.
Preserve project-native component/token/asset precedence when fidelity is satisfied.
